title: How do I export statistics?
intent: This article explains how to export aggregated statistics from survey results.
short_answer: To export statistics, navigate to the Exports page and select 'Export Statistics'. Choose a format (XLS, XLSX, ODS, or PDF/DOCX). The export generates aggregated data showing response distributions, percentages, and charts for each question.
procedure: Wait for the asynchronous export to complete.
important_conditions: Statistics exports show aggregated response counts and percentages per question.
Available formats: XLS, XLSX, ODS, PDF (DOCX).
For quiz surveys, a separate 'Export Statistics Quiz' type is available with scoring data.
Charts can be included in the export.
troubleshooting: Export not completing: Large surveys may take longer. Wait for the timeout period.
